text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(karen, x) ::: Karen binge-watches x.
Download(karen, x) ::: Karen downloads x.
Share(karen, x, lisa) ::: Karen shares x to Lisa.
Show(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
NegDownload(x) ::: Karen does not download x.
Premises:
Show("Stranger Things") ::: "Stranger Things" is a Netflix show.
Popular(x) → BingeWatch(karen, x) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
BingeWatch(karen, x) ↔ Download(karen, x) ::: Karen binge-watches a show if and only if she downloads it.
NegDownload("Black Mirror") ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
Show("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
BingeWatch(karen, x) → Share(karen, x, lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches a show, she will share it to Lisa.
Conclusion:
Popular("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
